title: Custom OOC Title
body:
Syntax: title <words> | title set <words> | title color <name|0-255> | title clear

Sets a cosmetic title after your name on the OOC channel, its emotes and in chatlog. The title can be up to 40 plain characters. Colors are chosen with TITLE COLOR (named colors: red, green, yellow, blue, cyan, magenta, purple, white, gray, orange, pink, gold; or numbers 0-255). TITLE shows your current title and preview. TITLE CLEAR removes it. Example: title The Last Uchiha; title color gold.

Titles do not change your actual player/account name and save across logout/reboot.
